verdict.rationale: Grok's first-party docs cover the whole story. Grok Imagine generates images from text prompts, with batch generation and control over aspect ratio, resolution and quality. It also edits an existing image from a source image plus a prompt, accepting up to five source images, and the release notes add wide aspect ratios for both generation and editing. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of image generation and editing quality, since the community evidence does not discuss images.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can generate and edit images from natural-language prompts

citations.quote: Generate images from text prompts with Grok Imagine models. The API supports batch generation of multiple images, and control over aspect ratio, resolution, and quality.
Edit an existing image by providing a source image along with your prompt. The model understands the image content and applies your requested changes.
Create images and video with Grok Imagine.
Use up to five source images for a single image edit.
